### A Guide Is Better Than a Map
Author: Whitney Hopler
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/ibelieve-truth-a-devotional-for-women/a-guide-is-better-than-a-map.html
Passage: Exodus 13:21
Points:
- Having a personal guide is far better than having a static roadmap for life.
- The Israelites did not need complex navigation tools because God visibly directed their every move.
- God understands the future and provides real-time guidance and encouragement at just the right moment.
- Believers can release the urge to control their path and trust God to reveal the next step.

### Dear God: I Want a Cloud, Too
Author: Tracie Miles
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-february-10-2017.html
Passage: Exodus 13:21
Points:
- Striving to find obvious signs or perfect clarity in decision-making often leads to exhaustion and anxiety.
- God chose the longer, more challenging desert route for Israel to protect their hearts and build dependence on Him.
- Even without visible clouds or signs today, God's guiding presence is always with His people.
- Believers can rest knowing that God walks with them in the wilderness and will gently redirect their steps.
